summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 5, 2026, reporting monthly passenger traffic data for July 2026. Total traffic decreased 1.9% year-over-year to 6.4 million passengers, with declines in Mexico and Puerto Rico offset by growth in Colombia. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, providing investors with periodic traffic metrics.
